hypothesis: Consistent with the existing Q10 audit's three-for-three CSIM finding (PQK-v2, QRC-10, VQC-v5; docs/research/Q10_AUDIT__classical-simulability.md), CVaR-QAOA as simulated in 1B is CSIM by provenance at every n tested (NumPy statevector execution by construction), and the crossover n at which exact classical simulation becomes infeasible is far beyond any n reachable by this phase's compute budget.
benchmark_problem: EXP-B1's instance ladder, extended for the entanglement/memory diagnostic up to n<=24 (structural diagnostic only, no fresh optimization needed above n=10 -- reuses EXP-B1's optimized (gamma,beta) where n overlaps, uses representative/random angles for the extended-n memory curve)
classical_comparator: n/a -- structural/provenance classification, not a solve comparison
quantum_method: Statevector memory (2^n x 16 bytes) and Schmidt-rank/bipartite entanglement entropy across the middle bipartition, vs n and p
stopping_rule: n up to the largest value where statevector construction stays under 4 GiB (n<=27); report theoretical crossover point even if not reached empirically

pass_fail_interpretation.classification_only: not pass/fail -- prohibited conclusion is the gate (see below)

prohibited_conclusion: claiming any n tested in 1B constitutes evidence of quantum advantage -- CSIM at every such n forecloses that by construction, per the same logic already accepted for QRC-10/VQC-v5 in the existing Q10 audit
